name: oxygen_diffusion
source: dimensionless; with uptake sets ~120-170 um penetration, consistent with Thomlinson & Gray 1955

source: simulator constant (linear uptake)

name: oxygen_mm_vmax
source: Michaelis-Menten uptake

source: Michaelis-Menten half-saturation

name: oxygen_vessel_source

name: proliferation_oxygen_threshold

name: necrosis_threshold
source: PhysiCell necrosis onset 5 mmHg / 38 mmHg = 0.13; here 0.06

name: necrosis_exposure_time
source: sustained hypoxia before necrosis

name: hypoxic_death_rate
source: after exposure time is exceeded

name: necrotic_clearance_rate
source: dead-cell clearance; apoptotic clearance is hours, necrotic debris days-weeks

name: vessel_spacing
source: tumour intercapillary distance 100-200 um (Thomlinson & Gray 1955; Vaupel 1989)

source: max change per SOR sweep
